definitions: The central part of a wheel, rotating on or with the axle, and from which the spokes radiate.
The effective centre of an activity, region, or network.
A central airport or other transport terminal through which many services operate.
A device for connecting multiple Ethernet devices.
A central point from which something is distributed or where it is concentrated.
examples: The hub of the wheel was rusty.
London is a major financial hub.
The airport serves as a regional hub.
Connect the computers to the hub.
The city became a hub for innovation.
